reviewedCustomerLinks.decisionRoute: signed-in OpenFolk operator customer-card review UI
reviewedCustomerLinks.corroboration: unique current Commusoft and QuickBooks source pair; exact normalized customer name, email, phone and full recorded address; existing card title agrees

limitations: This evidence does not prove complete customer matching or historical accounting reconciliation.
The third recurring scan must complete and the next unattended cycle must be checked.
QuickBooks transactions are linked to reviewed customers, not to individual Commusoft jobs.
A surname-only household and a name/address-only organisation remain unlinked pending stronger identity evidence.
